documents.title: NDA — Acme Ltd
documents.content:
NDA — Acme Ltd

1. Definitions
1.1 Each party may disclose Confidential Information to the other.
1.2 Confidential Information means all information disclosed, whether or not marked.
2. Exclusions: information that is public, already known, independently developed, or required by law to be disclosed.
3. Use: the receiving party may share with its employees and professional advisers who need to know.
5. Return: return or destroy on written request; one archival copy may be kept.
7. Term
7.1 This agreement runs for two years from the date hereof.
8. Remedies: injunctive relief.
9. Law: England and Wales.
